"correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Distance (d) = 5 km

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Time taken in the morning (t1) = 1 hour

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Time taken in the evening (t2) = 1 hour 15 minutes = 1.25 hours

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Average speed = Total distance / Total time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Total distance = 5 km + 5 km = 10 km

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Total time = 1 hour + 1.25 hours = 2.25 hours

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Average speed = 10 km / 2.25 hours

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Average speed = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) km/h

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct answer is option 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दूरी (d) = 5 किमी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              सुबह लिया गया समय (t1) = 1 घंटा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              शाम को लिया गया समय (t2) = 1 घंटा 15 मिनट = 1.25 घंटे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              औसत चाल = कुल दूरी / कुल समय

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              कुल दूरी = 5 किमी + 5 किमी = 10 किमी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              कुल समय = 1 घंटा + 1.25 घंटे = 2.25 घंटे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ औसत चाल = 10 किमी / 2.25 घंटे

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ औसत चाल = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) किमी/घंटा

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ఇవ్వబడింది:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ఉదయం పట్టిన సమయం (t1) = 1 గంట

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              సాయంత్రం పట్టిన సమయం (t2) = 1 గంట 15 నిమిషాలు = 1.25 గంటలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              సగటు వేగం = మొత్తం దూరం / మొత్తం సమయం

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              గణన:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              మొత్తం దూరం = 5 కి.మీ + 5 కి.మీ = 10 కి.మీ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              మొత్తం సమయం = 1 గంట + 1.25 గంటలు = 2.25 గంటలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ సగటు వేగం = 10 కి.మీ / 2.25 గంటలు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ సగటు వేగం = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) కి.మీ/గంట

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ సరైన సమాధానం 2వ ఎంపిక.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              दिलेले:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              सकाळी लागलेला वेळ (t1) = 1 तास

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              संध्याकाळी लागलेला वेळ (t2) = 1 तास 15 मिनिटे = 1.25 तास

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              सरासरी गती = एकूण अंतर / एकूण वेळ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              एकूण अंतर = 5 किमी + 5 किमी = 10 किमी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              एकूण वेळ = 1 तास + 1.25 तास = 2.25 तास

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ सरासरी गती = 10 किमी / 2.25 तास

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ सरासरी गती = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) किमी/तास

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ योग्य उत्तर पर्याय 2 आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              সন্ধ্যায় সময় লাগে (t2) = 1 ঘন্টা 15 মিনিট = 1.25 ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              অনুসৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              গড় গতিবেগ = মোট দূরত্ব / মোট সময়

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              মোট সময় = 1 ঘন্টা + 1.25 ঘন্টা = 2.25 ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ গড় গতিবেগ = 10 কিমি / 2.25 ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ গড় গতিবেগ = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) কিমি/ঘন্টা

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ সঠিক উত্তরটি হলো বিকল্প 2

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ઉપયોગમાં લેવાયેલ સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ સરેરાશ ગતિ = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) કિમી/કલાક

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ ಆಯ್ಕೆ 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              கொடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளவை:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              பயன்படுத்தப்பட்ட சூத்திரம்:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              சராசரி வேகம் = மொத்த தூரம் / மொத்த நேரம்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              கணக்கீடு:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              மொத்த தூரம் = 5 கி.மீ + 5 கி.மீ = 10 கி.மீ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              மொத்த நேரம் = 1 மணி நேரம் + 1.25 மணி நேரம் = 2.25 மணி நேரம்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ சராசரி வேகம் = 10 கி.மீ / 2.25 மணி நேரம்

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ சராசரி வேகம் = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) கி.மீ/மணி

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ∴ சரியான பதில் விருப்பம் 2.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ଦିଆଯାଇଛି:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ସକାଳେ ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ସମୟ (t1) = 1 ଘଣ୍ଟା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ସମୟ (t2) = 1 ଘଣ୍ଟା 15 ମିନିଟ୍ = 1.25 ଘଣ୍ଟା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ସୂତ୍ର:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ମୋଟ ଦୂରତା = 5 କିମି + 5 କିମି = 10 କିମି

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ହାରାହାରି ବେଗ = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) କିମି/ଘଣ୍ଟା

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਦਿੱਤਾ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਸ਼ਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਲਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ (t2) = 1 ਘੰਟਾ 15 ਮਿੰਟ = 1.25 ਘੰਟੇ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਵਰਤਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਫਾਰਮੂਲਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = ਕੁੱਲ ਦੂਰੀ / ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਗਣਨਾ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਕੁੱਲ ਦੂਰੀ = 5 ਕਿ.ਮੀ. + 5 ਕਿ.ਮੀ. = 10 ਕਿ.ਮੀ.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ਕੁੱਲ ਸਮਾਂ = 1 ਘੰਟਾ + 1.25 ਘੰਟੇ = 2.25 ਘੰਟੇ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = 10 ਕਿ.ਮੀ. / 2.25 ਘੰਟੇ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ ਔਸਤ ਗਤੀ = \\(4 \\frac{4}{9}\\) ਕਿ.ਮੀ./ਘੰਟਾ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The correct answer is maximum at the centre.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The magnetic field strength in a current-carrying circular loop is maximum at the center of the loop.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • At the center of the loop, the magnetic field lines are most concentrated, leading to the highest field strength.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • As you move towards the periphery of the loop, the magnetic field strength decreases.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The magnetic field strength at the center of a circular loop is given by the formula B = (μ₀I)/(2R), where B is the magnetic field, μ₀ is the permeability of free space, I is the current, and R is the radius of the loop.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • This concept is based on the Biot-Savart law which describes the magnetic field generated by a steady current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Biot-Savart Law\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • This law helps in calculating the magnetic field generated by a steady current.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It states that the magnetic field at a point is directly proportional to the current and inversely proportional to the distance from the current element.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Right Hand Rule\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • This rule is used to determine the direction of the magnetic field around a current-carrying conductor.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • According to this rule, if you point the thumb of your right hand in the direction of the current, the direction in which your fingers curl gives the direction of the magnetic field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Magnetic Field Lines\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • These are imaginary lines used to represent the magnetic field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • The density of these lines indicates the strength of the magnetic field.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Closer lines represent stronger magnetic fields, while lines further apart indicate weaker fields.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
